reason: The indexed orthorhombic F-centered cell, Z = 4, and a tetrahedral zinc-blende-derived average framework are strongly supported, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. The comparable-score report is unavailable, and the quoted 4.2% value is a self-computed unweighted profile residual; its RMSE is about 0.179 versus a background-noise level near 0.10, leaving substantial structured peak-intensity residuals. More importantly, only the best ideal zinc-blende ordering was coordinate-refined: a distinct runner-up ordering (ideal MSE 0.568 versus 0.442) and the chemically motivated lower-symmetry family were not refined and compared on equal footing, so the submitted Fmm2 symmetry, coordinates, and Zn/Sn/S/Se ordering remain unresolved. The selected geometry also includes an unusually short Zn-Se distance of about 2.17 angstrom and a long Zn-S distance of about 2.53 angstrom. A further attempt that instantiates and jointly refines the surviving lower-symmetry/order alternatives could plausibly improve the candidate set.
